name: Stubborn Women
overview: The Scriptures provide a clear standard for the role of women within the marriage relationship, emphasizing submission to their husbands as to the Lord, reflecting the church's submission to Christ (Ephesians 5:22, 24). While the account of Queen Vashti in Esther 1 describes her as a woman who exercised her own will, the Bible contrasts this with the virtuous woman whose value far exceeds rubies (Proverbs 31:10), highlighting godly character and obedience. This study invites believers to understand the biblical call for wives to honor their God-ordained role, fostering harmony and reflecting Christ’s authority in the home.
